Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome properties {#properties}

List, show, fetch, create and update project properties.

```text
apiome properties [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`create`](#properties-create), [`get`](#properties-get), [`list`](#properties-list), [`show`](#properties-show), [`update`](#properties-update).

## apiome properties create {#properties-create}

Create a property from a primitive (POST /v1/properties/{tenant}/{project}).

The primitive's JSON Schema is copied in; each example is checked against it locally.

On a terminal, missing fields are asked for. Properties have no tags.

Exit 7, one line per field, when the property is invalid.

```text
apiome properties create [OPTIONS] PROJECT
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | text |  |  | Property name (unique in the project). |
| `--primitive` | text |  |  | Primitive whose schema the property copies: name, UUID or $id. |
| `--description` | text |  |  | What the property holds. |
| `--example` | text (repeatable) |  |  | An example value (repeatable); read as JSON when it parses, else as text. |
| `--from-file` | path |  |  | JSON or YAML object with name, primitive, description and examples. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  | Skip the final question the prompts ask. |

## apiome properties get {#properties-get}

Fetch one property by id (GET /v1/properties/{tenant_slug}/{project_id}/{id}).

```text
apiome properties get [OPTIONS] PROPERTY_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROPERTY_ID` | uuid | yes | Property UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project-id` | uuid |  | yes | Project UUID. |

## apiome properties list {#properties-list}

List a project's properties with their type and the classes that use them (GET /v1/properties/{tenant}/{project}).

Properties have no tags and are not bound to primitives, so the TYPE column is read from each property's JSON Schema (its format, else its type).

```text
apiome properties list [OPTIONS] [PROJECT]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text |  | Project slug or UUID (or pass --project-id). |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project-id` | uuid |  |  | Project UUID (the older form). |
| `--type`, `--primitive` | text |  |  | Only properties of this schema type, e.g. string, uuid, date-time, array&lt;string&gt;. |
| `--search` | text |  |  | Case-insensitive text in the name or description. |
| `--unused` | flag |  |  | Only properties no class uses. |
| `--limit` | integer range | `50` |  | Show at most this many. |
| `--all` | flag |  |  | Show every match (ignores --limit). |

## apiome properties show {#properties-show}

Show one property: its type, constraints, examples, description and the classes that use it.

The name is matched exactly, then ignoring case; a miss suggests the closest names (exit 2). ``--json`` prints the full property with ``usage`` of ``{class_name, attribute_name, required}``.

```text
apiome properties show [OPTIONS] PROJECT PROPERTY
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `PROPERTY_REF` | text | yes | Property name or UUID. |

## apiome properties update {#properties-update}

Change a property's name, description, primitive or examples (PUT /v1/properties/{tenant}/{project}/{id}).

Only changed fields are sent. A concurrent edit since the read (or the file) exits 6.

--primitive is refused (exit 6) while a class requires the property, unless --allow-breaking.

Field problems exit 7. Properties have no tags.

```text
apiome properties update [OPTIONS] PROJECT PROPERTY
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `PROPERTY_REF` | text | yes | Property name or UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | text |  |  | Rename the property. |
| `--primitive` | text |  |  | Re-copy the schema from this primitive (name, UUID or $id); keeps examples. |
| `--description` | text |  |  | New description; an empty string clears it. |
| `--add-example` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Add an example (repeatable). |
| `--remove-example` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Remove an example (repeatable). |
| `--required-everywhere` / `--optional-everywhere` | flag | `--optional-everywhere` |  | Mark it required (or optional) on every class attribute using it, in unpublished versions. |
| `--from-file` | path |  |  | Apply an edited `properties show --json` dump (JSON or YAML); exit 6 if it changed since. |
| `--allow-breaking` | flag |  |  | Change the primitive even though classes require the property. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  |  | Print the changes as a diff without sending them. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  | Skip the question --primitive and --required-everywhere ask. |
